utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Down here if you want to send her some. Down where? Right there.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: That little thing? Yep, hit it. Oh.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Oh! Yay! Sending an email to someone. To, um—

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: No, she just is using the wrong email.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Is that why I didn't get any messages?

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: If it's new, it'll have that blue dot next to it.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, okay. Yeah, it probably will. Old people like to talk. I'm not old, but she's old.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I'll hire you as my secretary. You want to be my secretary?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Do you know how to do a group one?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Yeah, like you write it and it goes to 10 people.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Just tap the plus sign and add the names! It's not that hard, Grandma, you're just staring at it.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I'm trying, but the screen keeps changing every time I touch it, it makes me nervous I'll delete something.
